name: Primary Hot-Rolled Automotive Steel (India BF-BOF)
production_route: Integrated Blast Furnace - Basic Oxygen Furnace
notes_and_limitations: India BF-BOF route steel emission factor imported via CSV pipeline

name: Carbon steel / automotive steel
notes_and_limitations: Primary steel vs recycled/EAF route changes result substantially. Store range and source rather than false-precision single value.

name: Cast iron
grade_or_type: Automotive grey/ductile cast iron (engine blocks, rotors)
notes_and_limitations: Separate iron production from casting energy (e.g., 32.0 MJ/kg in Section 4) if source does so to avoid double counting.

name: Aluminium, primary
notes_and_limitations: Electricity mix is a major driver (coal-heavy grids sit near upper bound); primary vs recycled aluminium must be kept separate.

name: Aluminium, recycled/secondary
notes_and_limitations: Indicative only; scrap allocation method (cut-off vs avoided burden) and remelting route matter significantly.

name: Copper
grade_or_type: Electrolytic tough pitch / wiring & motor winding copper
notes_and_limitations: Ore grade, smelting electricity carbon intensity, and recycled content matter.

name: Plastics (mixed automotive polymers)
grade_or_type: Average automotive polymer mix (PP, ABS, PA, PVC, PU)
notes_and_limitations: Do not use a single factor for all polymers if PP, ABS, PA, PVC etc. can be distinguished in detailed BOM.

name: Rubber / tyre compounds
grade_or_type: Natural & synthetic rubber (SBR/BR) with carbon black
notes_and_limitations: Natural/synthetic rubber production and tyre vulcanisation/manufacturing are distinct modules.

name: Flat glass / automotive glass
notes_and_limitations: Glass production and glass pane forming (16.0 MJ/kg in Section 4) may be separate in inventories.

name: Magnesium alloy
notes_and_limitations: Route and electricity sensitive (Pidgeon process vs electrolytic); usually small mass share (1–5 kg per vehicle).

name: Lithium-ion battery materials / pack
grade_or_type: Traction battery cells & pack (LFP, NMC, etc.)
production_route: Cathode, Anode, Electrolyte, Casing, Pack & Assembly
uncertainty_or_range: Use chemistry- and pack-specific source; commonly modelled per kWh
notes_and_limitations: Do not treat lithium carbonate factor as whole-battery factor; separate cathode, anode, electrolyte, casing, pack and assembly.

name: Manganese (alloying / battery element)
uncertainty_or_range: Mass reported in SWD(2023) 256 (7–8 kg/car); emission factor requires GREET/ecoinvent lookup
notes_and_limitations: Included in EU SWD(2023) 256 representative vehicle composition (8 kg in ICEV/HEV/PHEV, 7 kg in BEV). No screening factor given in Section 2.

name: Glass-fibre reinforced plastic (GFRP)
production_route: Glass Fibre Drawing + Polymer Matrix Moulding
uncertainty_or_range: Mass reported in SWD(2023) 256 (4–9 kg/car); use composite-specific factor or polymer screening proxy with flag
notes_and_limitations: Reported in EU SWD(2023) 256 Table (9 kg ICEV, 4 kg HEV, 5 kg PHEV, 5 kg BEV).
